name: Darius Najjar
source:
Darius is a construction foreman who works alongside Lloyd to bring his designs to life. Tall, strong, and a man of few words, Darius can be intimidating to some, but he’s really a softie once you get to know him!

[From [url=https://www.blitsgames.com/camp-buddy-scoutmasters-season-development-update//]official site[/url]]
